Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration: ONE plain sturdy medieval iron room key attached to a small oak tag shaped like a simple bed, a muted blue cord.. Reference 1 defines the item's exact DESIGN, materials, colors and any authentic house emblem. Reference 2 defines the ITEM ART STYLE only: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, painterly textured metal, leather, wood and cloth, crisp dark outlines, soft simplified shading, muted warm colors, gentle illustrated highlights, readable details and a clear silhouette at small thumbnail size. Not photorealistic, not CGI or a glossy 3D render. Preserve the item's design and heraldry from reference 1; never copy the symbols or house colors of the style reference. Show the entire isolated object, centered and large within the square, with about 10% clear margin on all sides. Slight three-quarter view where appropriate; long weapons may run diagonally from lower-left handle to upper-right tip. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; at most a very faint soft BLACK contact shadow immediately beneath the object. No person, hands, mannequin, scenery, floor, stand, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. Do not add unrelated objects.
ONE small SERVICE ICON for a welcoming medieval veterans tavern. Rustic oak, worn leather, plain iron, ivory linen, muted blue wool. Same hand-painted fantasy inventory style as references, clear dark contours and simple readable shapes. Center the complete compact object with a clean transparent margin. No people, anatomy, lettering, heraldry, scene, floor, shadow or glow. Genuine transparent PNG.
